title: Mechanism study of naringenin in treating sepsis-induced kidney injury based on network pharmacology.
authors: Wang, Wenwen; Chen, Fang; Hu, Yinlu; Sun, Da; Chang, Jing; Lin, Lili; Ding, Haixiang
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究柚皮素治疗脓毒症肾损伤的机制，核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study explored naringenin's therapeutic mechanisms in sepsis-induced AKI via network pharmacology. An integrative bioinformatics pipeline identified targets, mapped interactomes and validated results via molecular docking. The efficacy was validated using a cecal ligation and puncture-induced AKI mouse model. Histopathological changes were assessed through hematoxylin-eosin staining. Biochemical parameters, including blood urea nitrogen (BUN) and creatinine (Cr), were quantified. Pro-inflammatory mediators (IL-1 and TNF-alpha) were evaluated via ELISA, while Nrf2 and HO-1 protein expression was determined through Western blot analysis. The network pharmacology analysis revealed 3,449 potential therapeutic targets of naringenin in AKI treatment. Target analysis demonstrated significant associations with oxidative stress response and apoptotic signaling cascades. KEGG pathway analysis highlighted the involvement of the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling axis in renal injury. Experimental results showed that naringenin improved pathological changes in AKI mice, down regulated serum BUN and Cr levels, reduced inflammatory factors IL-1 and TNF- alpha levels and decreased the expression of Nrf2 and HO-1 proteins in sepsis-related AKI. The therapeutic efficacy of naringin in AKI is mediated through pleiotropic effects on multiple targets and signaling cascades, with its renoprotective mechanism primarily involving the regulation of Nrf2/HO-1 pathway-dependent oxidative stress reduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过网络药理学探讨了柚皮素在脓毒症诱导的急性肾损伤（AKI）中的治疗机制。采用整合生物信息学流程识别靶点、绘制相互作用图谱，并通过分子对接验证结果。使用盲肠结扎穿刺诱导的AKI小鼠模型验证了疗效。通过苏木精-伊红染色评估组织病理学变化。量化了生化参数，包括血尿素氮（BUN）和肌酐（Cr）。通过ELISA评估促炎介质（IL-1和TNF-α），并通过Western blot分析测定Nrf2和HO-1蛋白表达。网络药理学分析揭示了柚皮素在AKI治疗中的3，449个潜在治疗靶点。靶点分析显示与氧化应激反应和凋亡信号级联显著相关。KEGG通路分析强调了Nrf2/HO-1信号轴在肾损伤中的参与。实验结果表明，柚皮素改善了AKI小鼠的病理变化，下调了血清BUN和Cr水平，降低了炎症因子IL-1和TNF-α水平，并减少了脓毒症相关AKI中Nrf2和HO-1蛋白的表达。柚皮素在AKI中的治疗功效通过其对多个靶点和信号级联的多效性作用介导，其肾脏保护机制主要涉及调节Nrf2/HO-1通路依赖的氧化应激减少。
